from pathlib import Path
import os,json,subprocess,time,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();stage=root/'.local/step07-ci-history';frozen=json.loads((stage/'source-freeze.json').read_text());source=frozen['sourceSHA'];assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==source
origin=stage/'origin.git';workspace=stage/'full-history-workspace';assert not workspace.exists();env={**os.environ,'PATH':'/Users/dingshinn/.nvm/versions/node/v22.21.1/bin:'+os.environ['PATH'],'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL':'/dev/null','GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM':'1','GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT':'0'}
for k in ['DATABASE_URL','PGPASSWORD','TILESET_ASSET_ROOT','TILESET_PG_BIN','API_PORT','WEB_PORT']:env.pop(k,None)
commands=[];sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def run(label,args,cwd):
 start=time.time();p=stage/(label+'.log')
 with p.open('wb')as log:
  log.write(('ARGV '+json.dumps(args)+'\nCWD '+str(cwd)+'\n').encode());proc=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 raw=p.read_bytes();j={'label':label,'args':args,'cwd':str(Path(cwd).relative_to(root)),'sourceSHA':source,'exitCode':proc.returncode,'durationSeconds':round(time.time()-start,3),'log':str(p.relative_to(root)),'logSHA256':sha(raw),'logBytes':len(raw)};commands.append(j);(stage/'bound-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceSHA':source,'commands':commands},indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'label':label,'exitCode':proc.returncode,'seconds':j['durationSeconds']}),flush=True);assert proc.returncode==0,label
run('origin-update-own-candidate',['git','fetch','--no-tags',root.as_uri(),source+':refs/heads/candidate'],origin)
run('full-init',['git','init',str(workspace)],root);run('full-remote',['git','remote','add','origin',origin.as_uri()],workspace)
# Pinned checkout fetch-depth0 branch: all branches/tags and no --depth limit.
run('full-fetch',['git','-c','protocol.version=2','fetch','--no-tags','--prune','--no-recurse-submodules','origin','+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*','+refs/tags/*:refs/tags/*'],workspace)
run('full-checkout',['git','checkout','--force','-B','candidate','refs/remotes/origin/candidate'],workspace)
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--is-shallow-repository'],cwd=workspace,text=True).strip()=='false';assert not(workspace/'.git/objects/info/alternates').exists();assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=workspace,text=True).strip()==source
original=json.loads((stage/'shallow-reproduction.json').read_text());files=[]
for r in original['legacyFiles']:
 args=['git','show',original['legacyCommit']+':'+r['path']];p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=workspace,capture_output=True);assert p.returncode==0;assert sha(p.stdout)==r['sha256'] and len(p.stdout)==r['bytes'];target=stage/'legacy-sources'/Path(r['path']).name;target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(p.stdout);files.append({**r,'actualGitShowExit':0,'actualSHA256':sha(p.stdout),'actualBytes':len(p.stdout),'rawPath':str(target.relative_to(root))})
newWorkflow=(workspace/'.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_bytes();assert sha(newWorkflow)==json.loads((stage/'workflow-semantics.json').read_text())['workflowAfterSHA256'];assert not(workspace/'.env').exists()
(stage/'full-history-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceSHA':source,'checkoutDepthFromNewYAML':0,'shallow':False,'reachableCommits':int(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-list','--count','HEAD'],cwd=workspace,text=True)),'headMatches':True,'objectAlternates':False,'sixLegacySourceBytesSHAIdentical':True,'legacyFiles':files,'ownership':'Own isolated workspace and bare origin only; no existing .env copied, DB or API started/changed'},indent=2)+'\n')
run('isolated-install',['pnpm','install','--frozen-lockfile','--store-dir',str(stage/'pnpm-store')],workspace)
run('isolated-prisma-generate',['pnpm','db:generate'],workspace)
run('isolated-ci-format',['pnpm','exec','prettier','--check','.github/workflows/ci.yml'],workspace)
run('isolated-boundaries',['pnpm','check:boundaries'],workspace)
run('isolated-build-step07',['pnpm','build:step07'],workspace)
run('isolated-production-exports',['pnpm','verify:exports'],workspace)
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=workspace,text=True).strip();print('FULL_HISTORY_AND_ISOLATED_ENGINEERING_BUILD_COMPLETE',flush=True)
